$comment: Machine-readable registry of the diagnostic codes the pdfnative ENGINE emits (src/core/pdf-diagnostics.ts). Meanings and remedies are restated from the source messages; the error-parity rule of scripts/verify-docs.ts checks that every code named in the documentation exists here and in src/, and vice versa. The CLI's E_* codes and the MCP server's tool error codes belong to their own repositories (pdfnative-cli llms.txt / schema manifest, and the MCP guide's error table, checked against the published package by the weekly --online run) and are deliberately not mirrored here.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A document claims a PDF/A level (layout.tagged) while rendering text through the unembedded standard-14 Helvetica — no fontEntries were supplied.
diagnostics.standard: ISO 19005 §6.2.11.4.1 (every font embedded; veraPDF rejects the file)
diagnostics.remedy: Register an embedded Latin font (e.g. Noto Sans via registerFont('latin', …) + fontEntries) or drop the PDF/A level.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: An AcroForm field appears under a PDF/A claim — field appearances render through the unembedded base-14 /Helv font.
diagnostics.remedy: Drop the PDF/A level for form documents, or flatten the form before claiming conformance.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A DeviceCMYK image is embedded under a PDF/A claim whose OutputIntent is sRGB.
diagnostics.standard: ISO 19005-2 §6.2.4.3 (device colour must match the output intent; veraPDF rejects the file)
diagnostics.remedy: Convert the image to RGB or drop the PDF/A level.

sink.default: console.warn, deduplicated once per code per build
sink.strict: layout.strict: true throws instead (onDiagnostic is then ignored)
